Werden Sie Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung unseres gesamten Vertriebs.

Als Vertriebsleiter / Head of Sales (m/w/d) führen Sie nicht nur unser Vertriebsteam, sondern verantworten das gesamte Vertriebsergebnis – vom eingehenden Lead über Kontakt, Beratung und Angebot bis zum profitablen Auftrag. Ihr Ziel ist es, Strukturen zu schaffen, mit denen unser Vertrieb planbar, messbar und unabhängig von einzelnen Personen erfolgreich wächst.

Dabei entwickeln Sie bestehende Prozesse weiter, etablieren klare Vertriebsstandards und KPIs, verbessern Abschlussquoten und Forecasting und entwickeln unsere Mitarbeiter durch konsequentes Coaching zu einem leistungsstarken Vertriebsteam.

Wenn Sie unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz und ein tiefes Verständnis für zahlengetriebenen Vertrieb miteinander verbinden, erwartet Sie bei uns eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Unternehmensentwicklung.

und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase von Premium Solarglas.

Aufgaben

  • Strategische Vertriebssteuerung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer klaren Vertriebsstrategie zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Umsatz, Auftragseingang und Profitabilität.
  • Führung des Vertriebsteams: Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung von Innen- und Außendienst durch klare Ziele, regelmäßiges Coaching, Call-Reviews und verbindliche Vertriebsstandards.
  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Funnel: Steuerung und Optimierung des Vertriebsprozesses von Lead → Kontakt → Termin → Beratung → Angebot → Auftrag.
  • Vertriebscontrolling & KPIs: Steuerung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Auftragseingang, Deckungsbeitrag, Abschlussquote, Lead-to-Termin-Rate, Show Rate, Umsatz je Verkäufer und Forecast Accuracy.
  • Forecasting & Reporting: Aufbau einer belastbaren Sales Pipeline, Erstellung realistischer Forecasts und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Geschäftsführung.
  • Prozessoptimierung & Digitalisierung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Automatisierungen, digitalen Angeboten und Nachfassprozessen.
  • Recruiting & Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Auswahl und strukturiertes Onboarding neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie gezielte Weiterentwicklung und Leistungssteuerung des bestehenden Teams.
  • Kunden- & Verkaufsqualität: Sicherstellung einer professionellen Beratung, hoher Kundenzufriedenheit und konsequenter Verkaufsqualität sowie Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen.
  • Skalierung & Marktausbau: Entwicklung neuer Vertriebskanäle, Zielgruppen und Partnerschaften sowie Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen für weiteres Unternehmenswachstum.
  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Produktion, Operations, Finance und IT zur optimalen Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses.

Ihr übergeordnetes Ziel: Sie schaffen einen planbaren, profitablen und skalierbaren Vertrieb, der durch klare Prozesse, belastbare Zahlen und ein leistungsstarkes Team nachhaltig wächst.

Qualifikation

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Führung und Weiterentwicklung größerer Vertriebsteams
  • Erfahrung mit relevanter Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung, idealerweise im Bereich von 10 Mio. Euro oder mehr
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Vertriebsleistung anhand von Zahlen, KPIs und Conversion-Raten zu analysieren und zu verbessern
  • Erfahrung mit Forecasting, Pipeline-Management und Vertriebscontrolling
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Steigerung von Abschlussquoten, Umsatz oder Vertriebsproduktivität
  • Erfahrung im Coaching und in der systematischen Entwicklung von Vertriebsmitarbeitern
  • Fähigkeit, klare Erwartungen zu formulieren und deren Umsetzung konsequent nachzuverfolgen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, digitalen Vertriebstools und automatisierten Prozessen
  • Strategisches Denken verbunden mit hoher operativer Umsetzungsstärke
  • Unternehmerisches Verständnis für Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag, Kosten und Profitabilität
  • Sehr gute Präsentations-, Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Konfliktlösungskompetenzen

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht allein die Anzahl Ihrer Berufsjahre. Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die anhand konkreter Ergebnisse zeigen kann, dass sie Vertrieb strukturieren, führen, messen und skalieren kann.

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, unsere Vertriebsorganisation aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

data.title: Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d)

data.company_name: Social Value GmbH für eine bessere Gesellschaft
data.description:
Vertrauensvertrieb an Banken, Versicherer und Versorger – kein Verkauf über die eigene Person. Einstieg in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit dem Ziel, das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten.

Wir suchen keine schnellen Abschlüsse. Wir suchen die Person, die unser Neugeschäft in einigen Jahren führt und heute anfängt, sich das zu erarbeiten.

Seit 2008 entwickeln wir digitale Sponsoringformate für Banken, Versicherungen und Energieversorger. Mit vielen Kunden arbeiten wir seit Jahren zusammen, mit einigen seit über einem Jahrzehnt.

Aufgaben

Worum es geht

Kunden kommen zu uns, weil wir ihr Haus verstehen und entsprechend beraten. Bisher kam diese Beratung vor allem vom Geschäftsführer. Genau diesen Teil des Geschäfts geben wir jetzt Schritt für Schritt ab.

Du übernimmst ihn nicht über Nacht. Zu Beginn arbeitest du eng mit unserem Geschäftsführer zusammen und lernst die Beziehungen kennen, auf denen dieses Geschäft ruht. Mit der Zeit führst du sie selbst, und dein Ziel ist, über die Jahre das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten und deutlich zu vergrößern. Wir suchen jemanden, der genau das sucht: nicht eine Rolle ausfüllen, sondern eine aufbauen.

Warum das anspruchsvoll ist

Vom ersten Kontakt bis zum ersten Auftrag vergehen Monate und viele Gespräche. Aufträge entstehen über Vertrauen, Fachlichkeit und Empfehlung, nie über Druck. Deine erste Anlaufstelle sitzt meist im Marketing, in der Kommunikation oder im Vorstandsstab. Du verstehst, wie in solchen Häusern tatsächlich entschieden wird, gewinnst die Menschen, die deinen Fall intern vertreten, und führst ihn durch die Gremien, bis aus Interesse ein Auftrag wird.

Deine Gesprächspartner sind erfahren und erkennen sofort, wenn jemand nur Verkaufsrhetorik abspult. Wir verkaufen nicht über die Person, die vorn steht, sondern über die Sichtbarkeit und Fachlichkeit, aus der Vertrauen wächst. Genau die baust du mit auf. Nicht jede Anfrage trägt sofort. Wer dranbleibt, gewinnt hier.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Den Ehrgeiz, dieses Geschäft eines Tages allein zu führen. Diese Aussicht reizt dich, statt dich zu erschrecken.
  • Ein feines Gespür für Sprache und für Zahlen.
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Funktionen, vom Marketing bis zum Vorstandsstab. Du durchschaust ihre internen Abläufe und findest die Kompromisse, die einen Auftrag intern tragfähig machen.
  • Den Blick für Branchenentwicklungen, aus denen du konkrete Kommunikationschancen für unsere Kunden ableitest.
  • Die Fähigkeit, aus Ansprache und Formaten Sichtbarkeit zu bauen, die Vertrauen schafft, und dich am Ergebnis zu messen.
  • Erste einschlägige Erfahrung. Wichtiger als die Jahre ist uns, dass du lange Entscheidungswege aushältst und nach vorn willst.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung aus dem Agentur-, Beratungs- oder institutionellen Umfeld (Banken, Versicherer, öffentliche Hand).
  • Erfahrung mit Kunden und langen Entscheidungswegen in großen Organisationen.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch, schriftlich wie im Gespräch.

Benefits

Was du bei uns findest

Du beginnst nicht auf einem leeren Blatt. Unser Geschäftsführer öffnet dir den Zugang zu einem Netzwerk und einem Marktverständnis, die über Jahre gewachsen sind, und zieht sich in dem Maß zurück, in dem du Verantwortung übernimmst. Der Weg führt bis zur vollen Verantwortung für das Neugeschäft. Das ist das erklärte Ziel dieser Position, keine Aussicht zur Zier. Deine Arbeit ermöglicht digitale Mitmachformate mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Einstieg in Teil- oder Vollzeit mit überwiegendem Präsenzanteil für den engen Austausch mit dem Team.

Interesse?

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf. Ein förmliches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Und bitte erzähl uns nicht, dass du verkaufen kannst. Beantworte uns lieber gleich zwei Fragen, sonst sprechen wir im ersten Gespräch darüber:

  • Erzähl uns von einem Kundenprojekt, um das du lange gerungen hast, und was du daraus gelernt hast.
  • Wie stellst du dir deine Einarbeitung vor, und wo würdest du selbst anfangen?

Schick deine Bewerbung samt Gehaltsvorstellung an .

Kontakt: Lukas Dopstadt, Geschäftsführer,

A twelve-month, multi-track path into go-to-market, for ambitious graduates. You start as an SDR or Product Specialist and see the entire gtm motion - sales, solutions, marketing, revops, product. You leave knowing exactly how revenue gets built.

 

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

? do i need sales experience

sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. we hire for drive, communication and curiosity — we'll teach the rest.

? how long is it

twelve months, in three stages - you start as an SDR or Product Specialist, rotate through a mid-stage role, then specialize in an advanced one.

? what happens at the end

your advanced role becomes permanent - AE, AM, RevOps, Marketing or Product Management. real ownership inside reonic, not busywork.

? Start date

The program starts on 1st September with a batch of 3-4 people

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Graduated from a top university with strong entrepreneurial focus.

  • C2 level in German

  • Experience in a startup environment.

  • Be hands on.

  • Curiosity about how tech, operations, and business strategy come together in high-growth companies.

  • Structured thinker who’s not afraid to get into the details, run the numbers, and execute fast.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of one of the fastest growing VC-backed startup in Germany with 3000+ satisfied B2B customers.

  • A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

data.title: GTM Academy (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)

data.description:
Build the Commercial Team Driving the Energy Transition
Most recruiting jobs are about filling vacancies.

This one is about building the team that drives the growth of one of Europe’s fastest-growing start-ups - at the intersection of AI & climate tech.

At Reonic, we're building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers. Every SDR, Account Executive, Sales Manager, and Marketing hire you make directly influences how fast we grow—and how much impact we can create.

If you love finding exceptional commercial talent, moving fast, and partnering with ambitious hiring managers, you'll fit right in.

Please note this is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

What makes this role different

  • You'll own hiring across our Go-to-Market organization, with a strong focus on SDRs, Account Executives, Sales leadership, and other revenue-generating roles

  • You'll partner directly with founders and sales leaders on some of the company's highest-impact hires

  • You'll build talent pipelines before we need them—not after positions open

  • You'll have the freedom to experiment with sourcing strategies and continuously improve our recruiting engine

  • Your hires will directly influence our growth across Europe

No waiting for applications. No unnecessary processes.

Just finding exceptional commercial talent and convincing them to join a company that's changing an industry.

What you'll do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Sales, Business Development, and other GTM roles—from sourcing through onboarding

  • Proactively source exceptional SDRs, Account Executives, Sales Managers, and other commercial talent

  • Occasionally recruit for Marketing and other business roles as the company grows

  • Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, interview processes, and hiring decisions

  • Deliver an outstanding candidate experience with fast, transparent communication

  • Build scalable talent pipelines for key commercial positions

  • Continuously improve how we attract, assess, and hire top GTM talent



You'll thrive here if you…

  • Have 2+ years experience recruiting commercial talent in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Know what great SDRs, Account Executives, and sales leaders look like

  • Love active sourcing and outbound recruiting

  • Prefer ownership over rigid processes

  • Move quickly without compromising hiring quality

  • Want to build teams that directly drive company revenue

  • Nice-to-have: You need to know what a fast paced sales motion look like - or even better we have worked in sales yourself



Why join now

  • Competitive compensation and strong growth opportunities

  • High ownership from day one

  • Work directly with founders and commercial leaders

  • Gym membership or transportation ticket: choose between Urban Sports Club or Deutschlandticket

  • Uber Eats and Uber rides on us when you finish late

  • Join a high-performing team building one of Europe's leading climate tech companies


About Reonic
At Reonic, we're building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers.

We're replacing fragmented tools (CRM, design, proposals, project management, invoicing) with a single integrated platform that supports installers across the full project lifecycle. Today, more than 3,000 companies across 13 countries use Reonic, and it's just the beginning.

We're a well-funded VC-backed startup reshaping how the world uses energy. We work hard, move fast, and believe exceptional people build exceptional companies.

Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams.

  • Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results.

  • Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware.

  • Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases.

  • Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs.

  • Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data.

  • Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial.

  • 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments.

  • Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable.

  • Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis.

  • Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior.

  • Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature.

  • Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable.

  • Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with tools such as Ansys (Mechanical/LS-DYNA), MSC/NX Nastran, Altair (HyperMesh/OptiStruct/Radioss), or COMSOL is beneficial.

  • Experience implementing user-defined material models and subroutines in Abaqus (UMAT/VUMAT/UMATHT), including the ability to write and debug Fortran, is desirable.

  • Proficiency in scripting: Python for Abaqus automation and post-processing, and Python or MATLAB for closed-form and lower-order analysis methods used to size hardware and verify finite element results.

  • Proficiency with 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks or CATIA, is desirable; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial.

  • Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables.

  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable.

  • Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial.

data.description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level

  • Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs

  • Design, implement, and validate estimation algorithms such as Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and data-driven/ML methods, while respecting the certification limitations of ML-based approaches

  • Develop mission-aware predictors that ingest flight-profile and navigation data to predict SoF until safe landing, and compute the energy margin, the predicted surplus SoF at destination, and the SoF trend presented to the crew, updating on diversion, altitude, speed, and ambient changes

  • Develop aging and degradation models and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and validate the SoH algorithm against the applicable end-of-life criteria across representative mission and durability profiles

  • Ensure the algorithms align with ED-289 requirements for state observers and predictors and ED-309 methodologies for energy level information to the crew, and are consistent with the “Manage Energy” functional breakdown

  • Ensure the algorithms meet functional-safety expectations for a DAL B function: deterministic and bounded execution time, reproducibility, uncertainty bounds on outputs, plausibility checks, built-in test, and malfunction and fault detection

  • Derive, document, and trace algorithm requirements from ED-289/ED-309 and system-level functional analysis, and maintain traceability into the real-time battery management software specification using a model-based design approach

  • Support the real-time embedded realization of estimators and predictors on the pack, lane, and central control units (fixed-point implementation, Simulink code generation, MISRA C) and validate them on HiL setups

  • Define the test and analysis strategy for virtual and physical battery test benches and HiL rigs, and analyze cell, cell-bank, and pack-level data to evaluate algorithm accuracy, stability, and robustness across temperature, aging, and usage variability

  • Set the standard for documentation of methods, assumptions, and validation results

Your Mission:

We are seeking a (Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (all genders) to lead the design and development of the flight control systems for our battery-electric aircraft. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and integrating the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control systems, including both mechanical and electrically actuated elements, working in close collaboration with the flight physics, structures, and systems teams. You will drive the flight control system throughout its complete development lifecycle, from system-level requirements definition through architecture development, preliminary and detailed design, supplier coordination, integration, verification and validation activities, and ultimately system and aircraft certification. Working cross-functionally with structures, avionics, flight physics, systems, and overall aircraft design, you will ensure robust integration of the flight control system within the aircraft. As a senior engineer, you will play a central role in technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and the maturation of the overall aircraft configuration.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define, derive, and manage system-level requirements for the flight control system, ensuring alignment with aircraft-level requirements, program objectives, and applicable certification regulations (CS-23 and related operational requirements).

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition, architecture definition, interface identification, and traceability management.

  • Lead the detailed definition, development, and integration of the flight control system, covering installation design, kinematics, load paths, performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety considerations.

  • Own the technical coordination and oversight of suppliers and development partners, including requirement allocation, design reviews, verification activities, and compliance demonstration.

  • Support and contribute to system safety activities related to flight controls, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA/SFHA), Preliminary System Safety Assessments (PSSA), and Zonal Safety Analysis,in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Actively contribute to the design implementation and configuration control of the flight control system within the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU), ensuring proper integration with structures and other aircraft systems.

  • Support the flight controls certification process, including preparation and review of certification plans, compliance checklists, qualification documentation and execution, and participation in ground and flight test campaigns.

Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world's first electric nine-seater aircraft. As a PCB Layout Engineer (all genders) in our Technology division, you will own the physical design of the printed circuit boards at the heart of our high-voltage propulsion battery and power-distribution systems, turning engineering intent into flight-ready, manufacturable and certifiable hardware. Partnering closely with our electronics, hardware and manufacturing engineers from schematic to fabrication, you will apply IPC standards and aerospace-grade design discipline to hardware that must be safe, reliable and light enough to fly - work that directly underpins the propulsion battery system at the core of our mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Design, route and iterate multilayer PCB layouts from schematics, netlists and engineering requirements.

  • Define and document PCB stack-ups, controlled-impedance geometries and reference-plane strategies together with the hardware engineers.

  • Perform ECAD–MCAD co-design with the mechanical team, including STEP exchange, board-outline and keep-out definition, and connector and component placement against enclosure and thermal constraints.

  • Apply high-voltage layout discipline - creepage and clearance, isolation barriers and 3W spacing - in line with IPC-2221 and the demands of aerospace high-voltage battery systems.

  • Engineer for signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, manufacturability and thermal management, using thermal vias, heavy-copper and metal-clad constructions.

  • Create and govern the PCB component library — schematic symbols, footprints and 3D models - in accordance with IPC standards.

  • Ensure designs comply with IPC-2221, IPC-7351 and IPC-6012 (including Class 3 expectations for high-reliability hardware) and other relevant IPC standards.

  • Produce complete fabrication and assembly data packages: Gerbers, ODB++/IPC-2581, drill files, BOMs, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.

  • Perform design rule checks (DRC), electrical rule checks and layout-versus-schematic verification, and support design and readiness reviews.

  • Collaborate with electronics and hardware engineers to implement design changes and resolve layout issues.

  • Partner with PCB fabricators and assemblers to resolve DFM/DFA feedback and manufacturing topics, and to qualify new suppliers and processes.

  • Maintain rigorous revision control, configuration management and technical documentation across the hardware baseline.

 

Your Profile:

  • Diploma, associate degree or vocational qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology or a related field.

  • Minimum of five years of hands-on experience in PCB layout or electronics design support.

  • Proven proficiency with a professional ECAD tool such as Altium Designer (preferred), OrCAD/Allegro, Zuken, Eagle, KiCad or similar.

  • Strong working knowledge of IPC PCB design, fabrication and assembly standards, and the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

  • Solid understanding of multilayer stack-up design, controlled impedance and PCB manufacturing technologies (rigid, flex, rigid-flex, hybrid, thick-copper, metal-clad).

  • High attention to detail, disciplined documentation and configuration-control habits, and the ability to manage several boards and deadlines in parallel.

  • Effective communication and teamwork skills in an English-speaking, cross-functional engineering environment.

  • IPC certification such as IPC CID or CID+ is a plus.

  • Experience with high-voltage, high-power, high-speed, HDI (microvias, blind/buried vias) or mixed-signal PCBs is a plus.

  • Experience designing to high-reliability or Class 3 requirements, and familiarity with aerospace standards such as RTCA DO-160 (environmental) and RTCA DO-254 (airborne electronic hardware), are a plus.

  • Exposure to signal-integrity / power-integrity simulation and close collaboration with hardware engineers on SI/PI is a plus.

  • Familiarity with quality and compliance requirements in regulated industries (aerospace, automotive, medical or similar) is a plus.

Build the Future of Climate Tech with Phlair

We're solving humanity's biggest challenge, and it takes everything we've got.

The world needs more energy, not less. Fossil fuels powered our economy for decades, at the cost of our planet. At Phlair, we're inverting that equation with breakthrough electrochemical Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology that pulls CO₂ from the air for permanent storage or repurposing into carbon-negative chemicals.

We're not here to play it safe. We're here to win.

Why We’re Different?

We solve hard problems and are product-first. Our hydrolyzer-based Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology, enabling scalable and low-cost CO2 capture from ambient air. The electrochemical technology allows off-the-shelf components and is ideally suited to the intermittent nature of renewable energy sources.

With proven offtake agreements from customers such as Google, McKinsey, JPMorganChase, Shopify, Stripe, H&M, and Deep Sky; we're one of only seven DAC companies with real market validation.

Project Dawn isn't just our flagship; it's our shot to scale CO₂ removal globally.

Is this a fit for me?

We're building for the 3-5% who are energized by winning and thrive under pressure. Our pace demands people who see excellence as non-negotiable and execution as everything. We cherish work-life-harmony, not balance. If you need extensive structure or prefer playing it safe, we're probably not the right fit.

Don't tick every box? We value potential and spikes over perfect resumes. If you believe you can contribute to our mission at this intensity level, tell us why.

Your mission at Phlair

As a Growth & Operations Intern, you support Phlair’s commercial and go-to-market efforts across customer research, pipeline development, and strategic analysis. You work closely with the commercial team, CEO, and technical teams to help turn technology progress into real market traction.

This role is ideal if you want to understand how deep-tech climate companies sell, position themselves, and navigate regulation-driven markets.

  • Support go-to-market and business development efforts

  • Help structure and maintain CRM data, sales funnels, and market intelligence

This is not a “shadowing” internship. You’ll do real work that matters.

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in business, engineering, natural sciences, economics, or a related field

  • Prior internship experience in startups, consulting, sales, or venture is a plus, but not required

With proven offtake agreements from customers such as Google, McKinsey, JPMorganChase, Shopify, Stripe, H&M, and Deep Sky; we're one of only seven DAC companies with real market validation.

data.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

data.description:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

  • Bike rental discount

  • Optional company pension plan


Conditions

  • Application deadline: Open until filled

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.

  • Remuneration: The range is EUR 4,363 (Masters plus 5+ relevant years outside of university studies) to EUR 4,810 (9+ years relevant experience outside of Masters'), in accordance with level 4 steps 1 to 3 of our remuneration scales

  • Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.


Please apply with your CV and a cover letter addressing essential criteria, listing of three references, and include your earliest start date and salary expectations. Please use PDF format exclusively using the application form. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed.


We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience improving leadership productivity through AI-enabled tools and efficient operating rhythms.


Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

We could tell you about the free breakfast, the drinks in the fridge, and the 30 vacation days. Or that flexible hours and remote work are part of the deal. But honestly? That's just standard.
Here's what makes working with us in Frankfurt extra special:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere - Take your job with you on a workation and get inspired by new places.
  • Time for growth - A career framework to support your professional and personal growth with up to 6 extra days off per year for your development.
  • Social Day - One paid day per year to give back: volunteer, support a cause, or attend an environmental event.
  • Bike leasing - Stay fit and sustainable. We'll handle the contract and insurance.
  • Pick your perk - Choose the benefit that fits your life best: fitness membership, public transport pass, retirement plan, or a monthly bonus.
  • Dog Friendly Office - Bring your furry coworker along. Just make sure they don't steal anyone's lunch.
Hybrid work is a natural part of how we operate, but we also believe in the power of coming together. That's why we regularly connect in the office whenever it makes sense. And that's just the beginning. Ask us what else is waiting for you!


Your contact person

Send us your application, including your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, directly through our online portal via the "Apply for this job" button. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Patrick Ziegler.
We ask for your understanding that MATRIX42 can only accept applications online via the applicant portal in connection with our applicant management system due to the currently valid EU data protection regulations.

data.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Pour accompagner le développement de nos projets et répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous renforçons notre équipe Consulting. Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet déploiement pour piloter l’implémentation de la solution Vertical Expense chez nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes internes (technique, produit, CSM) et les interlocuteurs client (DSI, DAF, DRH, métiers).

Tu interviendras au cœur des projets, de la compréhension des besoins, au paramétrage de la solution, en passant par l’accompagnement des utilisateurs.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Piloter les projets de déploiement de A à Z, du cadrage à la mise en production.

  • Analyser les besoins des clients et les conseiller sur l’optimisation de leurs processus.

  • Animer les ateliers projet et assurer la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger et faire valider les spécifications fonctionnelles et les livrables projet.

  • Organiser et réaliser le paramétrage de la solution selon les règles métier du client.

  • Accompagner les intégrations techniques (connecteurs ERP/SIRH, SSO, API…)

  • Assurer les phases de tests, recettes, formations, et transfert vers les équipes support.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus de delivery.

  • Être un relais actif du retour client vers les équipes produit.

  • Assurer le suivi des projets et garantir la satisfaction client.


Ce qu’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience réussie en tant que chef(fe) de projet fonctionnel ou consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) dans le cadre d’un projet de déploiement (Solutions Finance, RH, ERP ou SIRH... est un plus).

  • Tu maîtrises les bases de données et SQL, et tu comprends les environnements web, API, SSO et formats d’échange.

  • Tu possèdes un bon niveau fonctionnel, notamment sur les sujets de comptabilité, frais professionnels et processus métier.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les projets multi-interlocuteurs et sais adopter une posture de conseil fonctionnel auprès des clients.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et communiques avec aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la réussite des projets et la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et bienveillante, favorisant le partage de connaissances, tout en développant ton expertise fonctionnelle grâce à des missions variées et un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien téléphonique RH.

  2. Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  3. Seconde mise en situation (en autonomie) : cas pratique de paramétrage sur un environnement de test.

  4. Échange avec la Head of Delivery, le Project Manager et RH (1h).

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, rémunération : 45k à 50k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

About the Team

We are hiring a Partnerships Manager based in France with primary responsibility for the French market. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will manage relationships with strategic partners in France and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for France, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note, this role is based in Paris with 3 days per week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own partnership strategy and execution for France, driving end-to-end partnership development and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of France and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond France or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and French

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of France, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
